title: Enhancing the proportion of three-coordinated Al active sites on Co/Al2O3 for efficient CF4 decomposition
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3530-3538
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00355E, Paper
Heping Chen, Hang Zhang, Xiaojian Wang, Wenjie Luo, Jialin Zheng, Kang Liu, Junwei Fu, Hongmei Li, Zhang Lin, Liyuan Chai, Nan Hu, Min Liu
